//: Shared contract for the line a photo carries in the app. Asserted from both implementations: cms/src/types/photo-credit.test.ts (the CMS's preview of the line) and test/features/destinations/photo_credit_test.dart (the app). If they drift, the CMS shows an editor one credit and the app shows visitors another. `line` null means the photo carries no credit line at all.
